camel_example: aliyun actiontrail DescribeTrails --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeOrganizationTrail false --NameList 'abc,def' --IncludeShadowTrails false
description_en: Queries the list of created trails
description_zh: 查看已创建的跟踪列表
kebab_example: aliyun actiontrail describe-trails --include-shadow-trails false --name-list abc,def --include-organization-trail false --api-version 2020-07-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTrails

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display shadow trails. Valid values:

false (default): Shadow trails are not displayed.
true: Shadow trails are displayed
parameters.help_zh:
是否显示影子跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：不显示。
true：显示
parameters.name: include_shadow_trails

parameters.help_en: The list of trail names to query. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的跟踪名称列表。多个名称之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: name_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query multi-account trails. Valid values:

true: Queries multi-account trails.
false (default): Queries single-account trails
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询多账号跟踪，取值：

true：查询多账号跟踪。
false（默认值）：查询单账号跟踪
parameters.name: include_organization_trail

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the trail was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
CreateTime.description_zh: 跟踪创建时间。时间遵循ISO 8601标准，使用UTC时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

EventRW.description_en:
The read/write type of events that are delivered. Valid values:

Write (default): Write events.
Read: Read events.
All: Read events and write events
EventRW.description_zh:
投递事件的读写类型，取值：

Write（默认值）：写类型。
Read：读类型。
All：读类型和写类型

HomeRegion.description_en: The home region of the trail

IsOrganizationTrail.description_en:
Indicates whether the trail is a multi-account trail. Valid values:

false (default): No.
true: Yes
IsOrganizationTrail.description_zh:
是否是多账号跟踪，取值：

false（默认值）：否。
true：是

MaxComputeProjectArn.description_en: The ARN of the MaxCompute project to which the trail delivers events
MaxComputeProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的大数据计算服务项目的ARN

MaxComputeWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the MaxCompute project
MaxComputeWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向大数据计算服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

OrganizationId.description_en:
The resource directory ID.  

This parameter is returned only for multi-account trails
OrganizationId.description_zh:
资源目录ID。  

只有多账号跟踪返回该参数

OssBucketLocation.description_en: The region where the OSS bucket is located

OssBucketName.description_en: The name of the OSS bucket

OssKeyPrefix.description_en: The prefix of the file name in the OSS bucket
OssKeyPrefix.description_zh: OSS存储空间文件名的前缀

OssWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the OSS bucket
OssWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向对象存储OSS存储空间投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

Region.description_en: The region where the trail resides

SlsProjectArn.description_en: The ARN of the Simple Log Service project to which the trail delivers events
SlsProjectArn.description_zh: 跟踪投递的日志服务项目的ARN

SlsWriteRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role assumed by ActionTrail to deliver events to the Simple Log Service project
SlsWriteRoleArn.description_zh: 操作审计向日志服务项目投递操作事件时，扮演的角色ARN

StartLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail started logging events. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
StartLoggingTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次开始记录事件的时间。时间遵循ISO 8601 标准，使用UTC时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

Status.description_en:
The status of the trail. Valid values:

Disable: Stopped.
Enable: Enabled.  
Fresh: The trail is created but not enabled
Status.description_zh:
跟踪状态，取值：

Disable：停止。
Enable：开启。  
Fresh：已创建跟踪，但未开启

StopLoggingTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail stopped logging events. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
StopLoggingTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次停止记录事件的时间。时间遵循ISO 8601标准，使用UTC时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'

UpdateTime.description_en: The most recent time when the trail was updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the UTC time zone. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
UpdateTime.description_zh: 跟踪最近一次更新时间。时间遵循ISO 8601标准，使用UTC时区，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
